title: Analysis-Oracle Corp goes for high-stakes ratings gamble in AI strategy
excerpt: Cloud computing giant Oracle Corp is on the cusp of a junk-grade credit rating and its shares have tanked as the artificial intelligence hyperscaler becomes...
content_html:
By Vidya Ranganathan

LONDON, Aug 4 (Reuters) - Cloud computing giant Oracle Corp is on the cusp of a junk-grade credit rating and its shares have tanked as the artificial intelligence hyperscaler becomes the fall guy of investors' concerns over the sector's debt-fuelled spending binge.

The U.S. multinational is an outlier among top software firms racing to buy chips and build computing power to leapfrog the AI boom, forced by its limited cash reserves to borrow heavily and undertake massive long-term leases.

The extent of the splurge came to light in June, ‌when Oracle's results for the fiscal year ending in May 2026 showed its free cash flows were negative, the bulk of its revenue was spent on capital expenditure and it had signed roughly $260 billion of data centre leases, some starting next year.

The disclosures rattled investors and put ‌Oracle squarely in the crosshairs of ratings agencies which have long warned about the company's heavily leveraged balance sheet.

S&P Global Ratings was the first to move, lowering Oracle's credit rating to BBB-, one notch above junk, in July.

As per Oracle's reported numbers, its debt of $129.5 billion was roughly 4.3 times EBITDA, or earnings before expenses such as interest payments, depreciation, taxes and amortisation.

A debt-EBITDA ratio above ​4 signals financial strains, but the ratio can vary with methods and metrics each analyst uses.

Oracle's peers Alphabet Inc., Amazon, Microsoft Corp. and Meta Platforms Inc. have ratios under 1.

Oracle's massive lease commitments, which it does not yet have to count as debt but which analysts include in estimates, paint an even more worrying picture.

"While multiple other hyperscaler providers are building out AI infrastructure, none are as leveraged or cash flow negative as Oracle entering into this build phase," Moody's Ratings said in its February note explaining its negative outlook on a Baa2 rating, one tick above S&P's.

Despite the scale and profitability of its software business, "leverage will increase materially in the near term and could approach 5x temporarily," Moody's said.

The funding needs are so large, Oracle will need to issue more debt despite its ratings being severely constrained, while it also cuts back on share buybacks and raises equity capital too, analysts said.

Oracle expects capital expenditures of up to $95 billion in fiscal 2027, though it expects repayments from customers for up ‌to $25 billion of that.

Oracle declined comment for this article. In earnings calls, it said it remains committed to disciplined ⁠capital allocation and preserving its investment-grade credit rating.

content_html_zh:
维迪亚·兰加纳坦

路透伦敦 8 月 4 日 - 云计算巨头甲骨文公司 (Oracle Corp) 正处于垃圾级信用评级的风口浪尖，随着这家人工智能超大规模公司成为投资者对该行业债务驱动的支出狂潮担忧的替罪羊，该公司股价大幅下跌。

这家美国跨国公司是顶级软件公司中的佼佼者，这些公司竞相购买芯片和建立计算能力，以超越人工智能的繁荣，但由于其有限的现金储备，被迫大量借贷并进行大规模长期租赁。

这场挥霍的程度在 6 月份曝光，当时甲骨文截至 2026 年 5 月的财年业绩显示其自由现金流为负，其大部分收入都用于资本支出，并且签署了约 2600 亿美元的数据中心租赁合同，其中一些从明年开始。

这些披露令投资者感到不安，并使甲骨文直接成为评级机构的瞄准目标，这些机构长期以来一直对该公司的高杠杆资产负债表发出警告。

标准普尔全球评级率先采取行动，于 7 月份将甲骨文的信用评级下调至 BBB-，比垃圾级高一级。

根据甲骨文公布的数据，其 1295 亿美元的债务大约是 EBITDA（扣除利息、折旧、税金和摊销等费用之前的利润）的 4.3 倍。

债务与 EBITDA 比率高于 4 表明财务紧张，但该比率可能因每位分析师使用的方法和指标而异。

甲骨文的同行 Alphabet Inc.、亚马逊、微软公司和 Meta Platforms Inc. 的比率均低于 1。

甲骨文的巨额租赁承诺（尚未算作债务，但分析师已将其纳入估计）描绘了一幅更加令人担忧的景象。

穆迪评级在 2 月份的报告中解释其 Baa2 评级的负面前景，该评级比标准普尔的评级高出一格，表示：“虽然其他多家超大规模提供商正在建设人工智能基础设施，但没有一家像甲骨文那样进入这一建设阶段，其杠杆率或现金流为负。”

穆迪表示，尽管其软件业务规模庞大，盈利能力强劲，但“杠杆率在短期内将大幅增加，并可能暂时接近 5 倍”。

分析师表示，由于资金需求如此之大，甲骨文将需要发行更多债务，尽管其评级受到严重限制，同时它还减少了股票回购并增加股本。

甲骨文预计 2027 财年的资本支出将高达 950 亿美元，但预计客户还款额将高达 250 亿美元。

甲骨文拒绝对本文发表评论。 在财报电话会议上，该公司表示仍致力于严格的资本配置并维持其投资级信用评级。
